description: Solarkataster NRW: Potenzialdaten Dachflächen-Photovoltaik is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by Open.NRW. Das Landesamt für Natur, Umwelt und Klima Nordrhein-Westfalen (LANUK) hat im November 2018 das Solarkataster NRW veröffentlicht. In diesem Rahmen wurde jedes Dach in NRW hinsichtlich seiner Eignung für Photovoltaik und Solarthermie in hoher Detailschärfe untersucht. Coverage: Open.NRW. The portal files it under the publisher Open.NRW. Its tags are energieatlas, energiewende, erneuerbare-energien, globalstrahlung, klimaschutz. It offers 2 resource(s) in DOWNLOAD, GEODATABASE. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
